text:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — proposing a new 'targeted throttle' rollout UX for feature flags. Idea: allow percentage rollouts scoped by selector buckets (route, org tier, quota class). WDYT?
AJ Chen: Love the idea. Quick q: is this per-flag only or can we bind the same rollout to multiple flags? We need to avoid combinatorial explosion.
Maria Lopez: Per-flag in the console, but bindings let you attach selectors (e.g., {route: /v1/embed, plan: paid}). UI would show effective percent per selector.
Kevin Park: Important: how does this interact with quota-based routing? If route-level quotas kick in, we shouldn't continue throttling the same tenants.
Samir Gupta: @Kevin Park good point. Proposal: evaluation order = routing -> quota -> throttle. Throttle applied after routing/quota decisions so it only affects leftover capacity.
Nina Patel: From API side we're debating modeling rollouts as resources (POST /rollouts) vs simple PATCH on flags. POST makes audits/rollback easier. Example API:
```
POST /rollouts
{
  "flag_id": "adaptive_cache_v2",
  "targets": [{"selector": {"plan":"paid"}, "percent":5}],
  "window_minutes": 60
}
```
AJ Chen: Strong +1 for rollouts-as-resources. Easier to attach telemetry, webhooks, and an audit trail.
deploy-bot: rollout-simulation started for flag 'adaptive_cache_v2' against 5% of 'paid' orgs. ETA 5m
Maria Lopez: Simulation telemetry looks okay so far. Two UX asks: (1) console needs a clear "who is in scope" explainer and sampling preview, (2) we need options for instant rollback vs graceful unwind.
Kevin Park: For graceful unwind we can linear rampdown over N minutes, and per-route backoff if error rates spike.
Samir Gupta: We should add an automatic guard: if error rate increases by > 10% and p95 latency > 200ms we pause rollouts and revert to previous config. Also emit a critical alert and mark rollout state=PAUSED.
Nina Patel: API shape proposal: POST /rollouts -> {id}; PATCH /rollouts/:id/traffic to adjust percent; GET /rollouts/:id/events for telemetry; webhook events on state transitions (STARTED, PAUSED, ROLLED_BACK, COMPLETED).
AJ Chen: Console idea: show an "expected impact" card using historical slices — small chart for estimated QPS affected and estimated cost delta if feature changes token use. Helps PMs decide percent.
Maria Lopez: UX nit: when multiple selectors overlap (route + org) show precedence and unique impacted count. Also diff view with risk badge (LOW/MED/HIGH) computed from historical failure/latency signals.
Kevin Park: I'll sketch a short sequence diagram for evaluation order (routing -> quota -> rollout -> telemetries) and post in this thread.
Maria Lopez: Thanks — @Kevin Park and @Nina Patel if you can own API + console contract, I'll own rollout guards and telemetry. Will coordinate with @AJ Chen for the expected-impact calc. :thumbsup:
